unit-circle.alt: The unit circle with points at the angles 0, pi/6, pi/4, pi/3 and pi/2 and their coordinates (1, 0), (square root 3 over 2, 1/2), (square root 2 over 2, square root 2 over 2), (1/2, square root 3 over 2) and (0, 1); also (-1, 0) at pi and (0, -1) at 3 pi/2. Each quadrant is labelled with the signs of sine and cosine.

sin-cos-graphs.alt: The graphs of y = sin x (solid) and y = cos x (dashed) from x = -pi/2 to 2 pi: waves between -1 and 1 with period 2 pi. Sine passes through (0, 0); cosine starts at (0, 1).
